name: Cosmo
description: Wind-Up Shark extended Wind-Up Magician plays into several Xyz ranks. Fire Fist offered a different route, using Bear and Gorilla to search Fire Formations and trade them for removal.

defining_cards.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Bear
defining_cards.why: Bear turned a Fire Formation into monster removal and could set another Formation after dealing battle damage.

defining_cards.name: Fire Formation - Tenki
defining_cards.why: Searching Bear or another low-Level Beast-Warrior left a Formation in play to pay for Fire Fist effects.

defining_cards.name: Coach Soldier Wolfbark
defining_cards.why: Its revival effect paired two Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warriors for an immediate Rank 4 Xyz Summon.

defining_cards.name: Fire King High Avatar Garunix
defining_cards.why: After a card effect destroyed it, Garunix could return in the next Standby Phase and destroy the other monsters.

defining_cards.name: Mermail Abyssmegalo
defining_cards.why: Its two WATER discards could trigger Atlanteans, search an Abyss Spell or Trap and set up a double attack.
